descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Standard Units of Measurement (E2.1-E2.4)
subject: Mathematics

curriculum_expectations.E2.1: choose and use non-standard units appropriately to measure lengths, and describe the inverse relationship between the size of a unit and the number of units needed
curriculum_expectations.E2.2: explain the relationship between centimetres and metres as units of length, and use benchmarks for these units to estimate lengths
curriculum_expectations.E2.3: measure and draw lengths in centimetres and metres, using a measuring tool, and recognize the impact of starting at points other than zero
curriculum_expectations.E2.4: use units of time, including seconds, minutes, hours, and non-standard units, to describe the duration of various events

unit_overview: A 5-day Grade 2 unit on standard measurement (E2.1-E2.4) framed around 'Measure Maven' — Roo the Ruler Rabbit and Cal the Calendar Cat. Day 1 explores non-standard units and inverse relationship. Day 2 introduces centimetres + metres + benchmarks. Day 3 measures and draws with rulers (zero-point matters). Day 4 introduces time units (seconds, minutes, hours). Day 5 closes with a Measure Marathon Capstone integrating all 4 expectations. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
unit_learning_goal: Children will choose units, use centimetres/metres + benchmarks, measure with rulers, recognize zero-point, and describe duration using time units.

lesson_arc.big_idea: Smaller units = more units needed. Bigger units = fewer units. INVERSE relationship.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can pick a non-standard unit and explain the inverse relationship.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Roo measures with cubes vs hands; children explore unit-size inverse.

lesson_arc.big_idea: 100 cm = 1 m. Use BENCHMARKS — fingernail = 1 cm, hockey stick = 1 m.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can use cm and m and estimate with benchmarks.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Cal teaches benchmarks; children estimate object lengths.

lesson_arc.big_idea: Always START at ZERO on the ruler. Read the number at the END of the object.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can measure and draw lengths with a ruler.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Roo measures pencils; children measure 6 objects with rulers.

lesson_arc.big_idea: TIME = SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS. We pick the right unit for the duration.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can describe duration using the right time unit.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Cal times events; children pick s/min/hour for everyday activities.

lesson_arc.big_idea: We measure LENGTH and TIME with the right TOOLS and UNITS.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can measure length and time using the right tool.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Children rotate through 4 stations: pick unit, use cm/m, ruler, time.

recurring_characters.name: Roo the Ruler Rabbit
recurring_characters.role: Lead character. Measure expert from G1, now using standard units. Anchors all 5 lessons.
recurring_characters.visual_description: A young rabbit with long ears, holding a colourful ruler and measuring tape.

recurring_characters.name: Cal the Calendar Cat
recurring_characters.role: Roo's partner. Time character. Cameo Lessons 4-5.
recurring_characters.visual_description: A small striped cat with a wall calendar over its shoulder, holding a stopwatch.

threaded_vocabulary.child_friendly_definition: A unit that isn't standard — like cubes or hand-spans.
A small standard unit. 1 cm = a fingernail width.
A bigger standard unit. 1 m = a hockey stick length.
A common thing we use to estimate a measurement.
A measuring tool with cm marks.
A very short time. 1 second = 'one Mississippi'.
60 seconds. About the time to brush teeth.
60 minutes. About the time of a math class.

pedagogical_notes: Grade 2 measurement transitions from non-standard to standard (cm/m).
Inverse relationship: smaller unit → more units needed. Foundational for proportion.
Zero-point on ruler matters — common pitfall to start at 1.
Time vocabulary builds on Grade 1 calendar work.
canadian_context_notes: Tim Hortons cup heights for estimation.
School bell schedules for hour/minute practice.
